t.zh: 石头有的稳、有的滑。每块石头下面写着青蛙在上面站稳的可能，0.9 就是十次里有九次站得稳。一条路线要每一块都站稳，可能性要连乘：0.9 × 0.5 = 0.45。
t.en: Some stones are steady and some are slippery. Under each stone is the chance the frog keeps its footing, 0.9 meaning nine times out of ten. A route needs every stone to hold, so the chances multiply: 0.9 × 0.5 = 0.45.

t.zh: 新元件<part-ref to="part:mul"></part-ref>：输出 a × b。
t.en: A new part, the <part-ref to="part:mul"></part-ref>: it outputs a × b.

goal.zh: 找出最稳的跳法：青蛙安全跳到最后一块石头的可能，最大是多少？
goal.en: Find the steadiest way across: what is the best chance the frog has of reaching the last stone safely?

how.zh: 跳法和<level-ref to="frogfar"></level-ref>一样：从前一块，或从 ↶ 那块。岸边稳稳的，可能是 1。
how.en: Jumps work as <level-ref to="frogfar"></level-ref>: from the stone before, or from the ↶ stone. The bank is solid: its chance is 1.

say.zh: 可能性要乘起来：用乘法器。

hints.zh: 到这块最稳的路线 = 来处最稳的路线 × 这块站稳的可能。
hints.en: The steadiest route to this stone = the steadiest route to where it came from × this stone’s chance of holding.

hints.zh: 两个来处，挑更稳的：取较大。
hints.en: Of the two places it can come from, pick the steadier: take the max.

body.zh: <level-ref to="cheapest"></level-ref>是加起来再取较小，这里是乘起来再取较大。换了运算，骨架还是那一副。
body.en: <level-ref to="cheapest"></level-ref> added and took the min; here you multiply and take the max. The operations changed; the skeleton did not.
